themes_detail.label: Animal Infestation Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary animal complaints on private property spiked to 5 this week versus 0.2 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 1900% increase (z-score: 10.97)—suggesting a potential rodent or pest outbreak in residential buildings that warrants immediate investigation into building conditions and pest control response.
evidence: 5 unsanitary animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 per-week baseline over 8 weeks
Z-score of 10.97 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Sharp acceleration suggests sudden outbreak rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents in buildings with multiple complaints to understand scope and timeline of infestation
Contact HPD and DOH to determine whether inspections have been triggered and what pest control measures are underway

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints jumped to 94 last week versus 25.2 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 272% spike (z-score: 5.3)—indicating a possible new construction project, venue opening, or event-related disruption in the district.
evidence: 94 commercial noise complaints last week vs. 25.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 5.3 indicates significant statistical deviation
Commercial noise is subset of larger noise pattern (total noise complaints: 1,983 in 90 days)
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 complaints with DOB permits to identify if new construction or renovation is driving noise
Survey residents and businesses on Amsterdam/Broadway corridor to pinpoint noise source and business type

themes_detail.label: Elevator System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints escalated to 30 last week versus 8.2 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 264% spike (z-score: 6.36)—suggesting widespread mechanical failures in residential buildings that may leave elderly and disabled residents stranded.
evidence: 30 elevator complaints last week vs. 8.2 weekly average over 8 weeks
Community board has standing request for building infrastructure repair funding, suggesting chronic deferred maintenance
reporting_angles: Interview residents, particularly seniors and disabled residents, about how broken elevators affect access to apartments and neighborhood
File FOIL request for HPD inspection records and violation timelines for buildings with multiple elevator complaints

themes_detail.label: Inspection & Response Team Deployment
themes_detail.summary: Complaints triggering Special Projects Inspection Team and Emergency Response Team spiked last week (7 SPIT, 3 ERT) versus 0.6 and 0.1 per-week baselines—increases of 1020% and 2300% respectively—indicating serious code violations or unsafe conditions warranting city intervention.
evidence: 7 SPIT complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (1020% spike, z-score: 9.16)
3 ERT complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Both metrics indicate emergency-level building code violations requiring specialized city response
reporting_angles: Obtain incident reports from HPD and DOB identifying which buildings triggered SPIT/ERT deployment and violation types
Interview tenants in affected buildings about safety conditions that prompted emergency intervention

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Collection Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Missed trash collection complaints hit 3 last week versus 0.2 weekly baseline—a 1100% increase (z-score: 6.35)—suggesting a temporary sanitation service failure or strike that may be creating public health hazards.
evidence: 3 missed collection complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over 8 weeks
Overlaps with outside building complaints spike (6 last week vs. 0.8 baseline, 700% increase)
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY for explanation of service disruption and expected timeline to resume normal collections
Survey residents on specific streets experiencing missed pickups to document neighborhood impact
